enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Eyes closed. Breathes slowly. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket. Turns to right side. Adjusts pillow. Moves arm under pillow. Shifts legs. Lies still. Continues sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth, and showering
enriched_activities.desc: Wakes up. Opens eyes. Sits up. Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Uses toilet. Flushes. Turns on shower. Adjusts water temperature. Steps into shower. Washes body. Shampoos hair. Rinses. Turns off shower. Steps out. Dries with towel. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Washes face. Dries face. Turns off light. Exits bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast (toast, kettle-boiled tea) while checking phone messages
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out bread. Puts bread in toaster. Presses lever. Fills kettle with water. Places kettle on base. Turns on kettle. Opens cupboard. Takes out mug. Takes out tea bag. Puts tea bag in mug. Waits for toaster. Toast pops up. Takes toast. Puts on plate. Butters toast. Kettle boils. Pours hot water into mug. Adds milk. Stirs tea. Sits at table. Picks up phone. Unlocks phone. Checks messages. Eats toast. Drinks tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and tidying the room
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Opens wardrobe. Takes out shirt. Takes out pants. Takes out socks. Puts on shirt. Puts on pants. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Makes bed. Pulls up blanket. Smooths sheet. Picks up clothes from floor. Puts clothes in hamper. Arranges items on desk. Adjusts desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting up the home workspace: turning on computer and monitor, reviewing the day's arts administration schedule
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Turns on computer. Turns on monitor. Adjusts chair. Opens calendar. Opens email. Reviews schedule. Makes notes. Opens spreadsheet. Updates grant information. Saves file. Checks phone. Sends message.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home as an arts administrator: answering emails, coordinating with artists and venues, updating grant and programme spreadsheets on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at computer. Opens email client. Reads email. Types reply. Sends email. Opens spreadsheet. Enters data. Formats cells. Saves spreadsheet. Makes phone call. Talks to artist. Takes notes. Sends follow-up email. Coordinates with venue. Updates programme spreadsheet. Saves file. Checks calendar. Replies to message.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating lunch with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Greets Member 1. Opens refrigerator. Takes out ingredients. Washes vegetables. Chops vegetables. Turns on stove. Places pan on stove. Adds oil. Adds vegetables. Stirs. Adds seasoning. Turns off stove. Plates food. Sets table. Sits at table. Eats lunch. Talks to Member 1 about morning. Listens to Member 1. Drinks water. Clears plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Quick washroom break and hand wash
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Uses toilet. Flushes. Turns on tap. Wets hands. Applies soap. Rubs hands. Rinses hands. Turns off tap. Dries hands. Turns off light. Exits bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Freelance illustration work: sketching and inking commissioned pieces on the monitor and computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Opens illustration software. Creates new canvas. Picks up stylus. Sketches lines. Uses eraser. Adjusts brush size. Draws shapes. Adds details. Saves file. Opens reference image. Continues sketching. Inks outlines. Uses zoom tool. Saves file again. Checks email. Replies to client.

enriched_activities.activity: Making a cup of tea with the kettle and taking a short break with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Greets Member 1. Fills kettle with water. Turns on kettle. Takes out mug. Puts tea bag in mug. Kettle boils. Pours water into mug. Adds milk. Stirs tea. Sits with Member 1. Talks to Member 1. Drinks tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing freelance illustration work and sending draft revisions to clients
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Opens illustration file. Continues inking. Adds shading. Saves file. Exports draft. Opens email. Attaches file. Types message. Sends email to client. Checks for feedback. Updates file. Saves again.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a short walk around the neighbourhood with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Puts on jacket. Puts on shoes. Opens door. Steps outside. Walks with Member 1. Talks to Member 1. Turns left at corner. Walks down street. Crosses road. Continues walking. Stops to look at garden. Walks back.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking to local shops to buy groceries for the week with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to local shops with Member 1. Enters shop. Picks up basket. Selects vegetables. Selects fruits. Selects bread. Selects milk. Goes to checkout. Pays. Bags groceries. Exits shop. Walks home with Member 1. Talks to Member 1.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Greets Member 1. Opens refrigerator. Takes out ingredients. Washes vegetables. Chops vegetables. Turns on stove. Places pan on stove. Adds oil. Adds ingredients. Stirs. Adds seasoning. Turns off stove. Plates food. Sets table. Sits at table. Eats dinner. Talks to Member 1 about day. Listens to Member 1. Drinks water. Clears plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and tidying up with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up dishes. Puts dishes in sink. Turns on tap. Adds dish soap. Scrubs dishes. Rinses dishes. Places dishes in drying rack. Wipes counter. Puts away food. Takes out trash. Ties trash bag. Talks to Member 1. Washes hands. Dries hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Selects channel. Watches TV. Talks to Member 1. Changes channel. Adjusts volume. Laughs. Comments to Member 1. Watches more TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and unwinding alone
enriched_activities.desc: Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Selects channel. Watches TV. Picks up phone. Checks messages. Scrolls social media. Puts down phone. Watches TV. Changes channel. Adjusts volume. Watches more TV. Turns off TV. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Personal illustration project: drawing on the computer with the desk lamp on
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Turns on desk lamp. Sits at desk. Opens computer. Opens illustration software. Creates new canvas. Picks up stylus. Draws sketch. Adds details. Uses color tool. Saves file. Checks reference. Continues drawing. Saves file again. Turns off computer. Turns off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on shower. Adjusts temperature. Steps into shower. Washes body. Shampoos hair. Rinses. Turns off shower. Steps out. Dries with towel. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Washes face. Dries face. Turns off light. Exits bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and winding down before sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Lies in bed. Picks up book. Opens book. Reads pages. Turns page. Continues reading. Closes book. Puts book on nightstand. Turns off lamp. Lies down. Closes eyes. Breathes slowly. Falls asleep.
